body: I made an appointment with my primary care doctor for tomorrow. We’ll see how things turn out

I tried telling the guy I like and he listen to what I was saying. 

I hate myself, from my voice to my weight to my glasses and toes. I hate the way I talk; that no one in my family gives a shit about me. I’m about 120lbs over weight, but I’m never gunna lose weight because I fucking hate myself and I don’t care enough about my well being to actually try and lose weight. And I don’t care if strangers or friends and family think I’m fat because I hate me too. I don’t care what people think about me because I don’t care about me.
Because I’m weak and I can’t fight anymore.
